description:
*3 Bed 1 Bath Home with garden *Walk to Town, MTU, UHK & Manor West Retail Park *Move in Condition *Set in established development  *Ideal Family/1st time Buyer Home *BER C- Talk to us to discuss how to get the home to a B and avail of green mortgage.

Tommy Carmody’s Property House are excited to bring 26 Fountain Court, Tralee, Co Kerry to the market.  

CALL OR TEXT TOMMY ON +35387706030 TO ARRANGE A TIME SLOT….

The home is situated in Fountain Court, a well established development which is within walking distance of Tralee Town Centre, UHK, MTU, Manor West Retail Park and so much more. Tralee, Kerry’s Capital and a University town has every imaginable amenity available including Retail, Commercial, Medical, Educational, Leisure, an excellent Bars, Hotels and Restaurants. The beaches of Fenit and Banna are a short drive away as is Tralee Golf Links while Kerry Airport is approx. 25 mins away. The new Astellas Campus is minutes away.

Accommodation 

Hallway: Naturally bright, inviting and benefits from understairs storage and a tiled floor.

Living Room: This is a very spacious room.  It is naturally bright given has a feature fireplace of brick surround and marble hearth. Situated to the front of the home.

Kitchen/Dining Quarters: Situated to the rear of the home over looking the rear garden it includes an array of floor and wall mounted units and has tiled floors and tiled splashback. Integrated cooker, hob, extractor fan, stainless steel sink and has allocated space for fridge/freezer and dishwasher. Leads to utility room…

Utility Room: Plumbed for washing machine/dryer, with tiled floor. Offers its own access to the rear garden. Leads to Guest WC

Upstairs

Landing: Leads to 3 x bedrooms, family bathroom, hotpress and attic access. With carpeted floor on stairs and landing.

Bedroom 1: This room is a great size. Situated to the back of the home it can easily accommodate a King Bed. With carpeted floor and built in storage. Overlooks back garden. 

En-suite: Complete with WC, WHB, Electric shower and tiled floor.  

Bedroom 2: Situated to  the front of the home it enjoys views out to the mountains. It would be an ideal king room or twin-room. With built in storage and carpeted floor. 

Bedroom 3: Situated at the front of the home, it would make an ideal single room, small double room, nursery or home office. Offers views of the mountains. With carpeted floors. 

Family Bathroom: Complete with Bath with shower fixture, WC, WHB, tiled floor and part tiled walls. Access to attic is currently from here but this access can be moved. 

Outside: There is off street parking to the front of the home, garden to the rear which would ideal for BBQ’s in summer.

Whilst every care has been taken in the preparation of these particulars, and they are believed to be correct, they are not warranted and intending purchasers / lessees should satisfy themselves as to the correctness of information given.
